verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document mapping data between Zap steps or transforming it with expressions, functions, formulas or code steps. Canvas 'visual mapping' refers to diagramming business processes, not data transformation, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. One community comment complains about having no way to write simple code or conditions.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map and transform data between steps with expressions, functions, or formulas
